description: Risk/credit domain pack: credit application, approval, disbursement, overdue and default analytics. Only used when the request semantics clearly belong to the risk domain.

metrics.name: 申请量
metrics.definition: number of loan applications in the period

metrics.name: AUC
metrics.definition: area under the ROC curve of the credit model

metrics.name: KS
metrics.definition: Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic of the score distribution

metrics.name: PSI
metrics.definition: population stability index comparing score distributions

knownAmbiguities.question: Which loan portfolio (e.g. 个人贷款, 企业贷款) should this analysis target?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: Different portfolios use different data sources and metrics.

knownAmbiguities.question: Which observation window should be analyzed?
Which risk metrics should be included (申请量 / 通过率 / 放款额 / 逾期率 / 坏账率 / AUC / KS / PSI)?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: The requested metrics determine what data to query.

knownAmbiguities.question: Compared to which period or baseline?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: A comparison request needs a reference period.

knownAmbiguities.question: Which model (or score field) should be evaluated?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: Model quality metrics (AUC/KS/PSI) require a specific model or score.
